description: A flexible e‑commerce platform offering REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs for storefront and admin integration.
access_requirements: Requires Magento admin credentials and a licensed Adobe Commerce instance
evidence_excerpts:
Three types of authentication :

Third-party applications authenticate with OAuth 1.0a .
Mobile applications authenticate using tokens .
Administrators and customers are authenticated with login credentials .
Support for GraphQL , REST (Representational State Transfer) and SOAP (Simple Object Access Protocol).

You must register a web service on Admin. Use the following general steps to set up Magento to enable web services.\nIf you are using token-based authentication, create a web services user on Admin...
